functional_requirements: Horizontal base provides a 50 mm x 30 mm mounting footprint.
Vertical arm provides a 30 mm wide upright mounting surface.
Inside corner fillet of 5 mm radius reduces stress concentration at the L-junction.
Part should be a single rigid bracket suitable for 3D printing.
special_features: The bracket MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y=0); all Y coordinates of the base and vertical arm MUST mirror about Y=0.

The vertical arm MUST be located at one end of the base along X, with VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X=5 mm along X, VERTICAL_ARM_WIDTH_Y=30 mm along Y, and VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z=30 mm above BASE_TOP_Z.
The vertical arm MUST extend 30 mm above the base top, so OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z MUST equal BASE_THICKNESS_Z + VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z = 35 mm; it MUST NOT be limited to 30 mm total height.
The vertical arm outer face MUST be flush with the base end face at X=ARM_OUTER_FACE_X=-25 mm, and the arm inner face MUST be at X=ARM_INNER_FACE_X=-20 mm.
The vertical arm MUST span the full BASE_WIDTH_Y=30 mm width from Y=BASE_MIN_Y to Y=BASE_MAX_Y.
The 5 mm inside fillet MUST be applied to the concave edge where the base top face at Z=BASE_TOP_Z meets the vertical arm inner face at X=ARM_INNER_FACE_X, running along the Y direction.
The inside fillet MUST be a concave radius that adds material into the L-junction; it MUST NOT be applied to the outer top edge of the vertical arm or the outer edges of the base.
No mounting holes or additional features are requested; the L-bracket MUST remain a simple two-leg bracket with only the specified inside-corner fillet.

sketches.notes: Base plate footprint centered on origin: X=-25..+25, Y=-15..+15, symmetric about the XZ plane (Y=0).

Vertical arm footprint drawn in the XY plane at the -X end of the base: X from ARM_OUTER_FACE_X=-25.0 to ARM_INNER_FACE_X=-20.0 (5 mm thick along X), Y from BASE_MIN_Y=-15.0 to BASE_MAX_Y=+15.0 (full 30 mm base width). Extruded upward from Z=0 so it passes through the base plate volume for a solid union.

Custom profile: concave inside-corner fillet fill (wedge bounded by two lines and one arc) drawn in the XZ plane. In XZ sketch-local coordinates x = world X and y = world Z. Straight edge along the base top face from (-20.0, 5.0) to (-15.0, 5.0); concave radius arc R=5.0 centered at (-15.0, 10.0) running from (-15.0, 5.0) up to (-20.0, 10.0) through arc midpoint (-18.5355, 6.4645); straight edge up the arm inner face from (-20.0, 10.0) back to (-20.0, 5.0). This closed region is exactly the 5x5 corner square minus the quarter disc (area 25 - pi*25/4 = 5.365 mm^2) and ADDS material into the concave L-junction. Extruded 30 mm along +Y, from Y=-15.0 to Y=+15.0.

steps.label: Extrude 50x30x5 base plate
steps.notes: Base plate occupies Z=0.0 (BASE_BOTTOM_Z) to Z=5.0 (BASE_TOP_Z).

steps.label: Extrude vertical arm at -X end
steps.notes: Arm solid spans Z=0.0 to Z=35.0 (OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z = BASE_THICKNESS_Z 5.0 + VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z 30.0). The portion Z=0..5 overlaps the base plate so the union is volumetric; above the base the arm is X=-25.0..-20.0, Y=-15.0..+15.0, Z=5.0..35.0.

steps.label: Extrude R5 concave inside-corner fillet fill
steps.notes: Extrudes the arc-bounded corner fill along +Y from Y=-15.0 to Y=+15.0 (30 mm, matching BASE_WIDTH_Y). The resulting quarter-cylinder-like solid has its curved surface tangent to the base top face at Z=5.0 (tangent line X=-15.0) and tangent to the arm inner face at X=-20.0 (tangent line Z=10.0). This is the ONLY fillet on the part: a concave radius that adds material into the L-junction; it is not applied to the arm top outer edge (Z=35.0) nor to any outer base edge.

steps.label: Fuse base plate and vertical arm
steps.notes: Union of overlapping volumes; result volume = 7500 + 5250 - 750 = 12000 mm^3.

steps.label: Fuse inside-corner fillet into the L-junction
steps.notes: Final fuse yields one connected solid; expected volume 12000 + (25 - pi*25/4)*30 = 12160.9 mm^3, matching the brief target of 12161.0 mm^3 (confirms the fillet ADDS material). No holes, no chamfers, no further edge finishing are required.

sketches.notes: Base plate footprint centered on origin: X=-25..+25, Y=-15..+15, symmetric about the XZ plane (Y=0).

Vertical arm footprint drawn in the XY plane at the -X end of the base: X from ARM_OUTER_FACE_X=-25.0 to ARM_INNER_FACE_X=-20.0 (5 mm thick along X), Y from BASE_MIN_Y=-15.0 to BASE_MAX_Y=+15.0 (full 30 mm base width). Extruded upward from Z=0 so it passes through the base plate volume for a solid union.

Custom profile: concave inside-corner fillet fill (wedge bounded by two lines and one arc) drawn in the XZ plane. In XZ sketch-local coordinates x = world X and y = world Z. Straight edge along the base top face from (-20.0, 5.0) to (-15.0, 5.0); concave radius arc R=5.0 centered at (-15.0, 10.0) running from (-15.0, 5.0) up to (-20.0, 10.0) through arc midpoint (-18.5355, 6.4645); straight edge up the arm inner face from (-20.0, 10.0) back to (-20.0, 5.0). This closed region is exactly the 5x5 corner square minus the quarter disc (area 25 - pi*25/4 = 5.365 mm^2) and ADDS material into the concave L-junction. Extruded 30 mm along +Y, from Y=-15.0 to Y=+15.0.

steps.label: Extrude 50x30x5 base plate
steps.notes: Base plate occupies Z=0.0 (BASE_BOTTOM_Z) to Z=5.0 (BASE_TOP_Z).

steps.label: Extrude vertical arm at -X end
steps.notes: Arm solid spans Z=0.0 to Z=35.0 (OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z = BASE_THICKNESS_Z 5.0 + VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z 30.0). The portion Z=0..5 overlaps the base plate so the union is volumetric; above the base the arm is X=-25.0..-20.0, Y=-15.0..+15.0, Z=5.0..35.0.

steps.label: Extrude R5 concave inside-corner fillet fill
steps.notes: Extrudes the arc-bounded corner fill along +Y from Y=-15.0 to Y=+15.0 (30 mm, matching BASE_WIDTH_Y). The resulting quarter-cylinder-like solid has its curved surface tangent to the base top face at Z=5.0 (tangent line X=-15.0) and tangent to the arm inner face at X=-20.0 (tangent line Z=10.0). steps.label: Fuse base plate and vertical arm
steps.notes: Union of overlapping volumes; result volume = 7500 + 5250 - 750 = 12000 mm^3.

steps.label: Fuse inside-corner fillet into the L-junction
